name: metrics_dragon
description: Metrics of one dragon tile instance, one row per sweep

sample_id.description: Identifier shared by every row of one sweep

sample_slot.description: Slot that triggered the sweep, 0 for periodic sweeps

sample_snapct_state.description: Snapshot load state entered, for snapct_state sweeps; unknown otherwise

sample_caught_up.description: Whether replay had caught up to the cluster tip when the sweep was taken (replay IsCaughtUp); set once per run, never cleared

sample_tile_cnt.description: Tile instances in the sweep, to detect partial sweeps

kind_id.description: Index of this tile instance among tiles of its kind

tid.description: Thread ID of the tile. Same as Pid in production, but might differ in development

last_cpu_index.description: CPU the tile last ran on

context_switch_involuntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Involuntary context switches

context_switch_voluntary.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Voluntary context switches

page_fault_major.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Major page faults

page_fault_minor.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Minor page faults

heartbeat_time.description: Last wall-clock time the tile heartbeated

is_backpressured.description: Whether the tile is currently backpressured

backpressure.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Times the tile waited for one or more consumers to catch up to resume publishing

regime_duration_nanos.description: Tile wall time, by regime; regimes are exhaustive and groups Busy, Idle, Backpressure and Housekeeping partition it

thread_duration_nanos.description: Thread wall time since start, by scheduler state; Idle is the remainder, so parts sum to about the lifetime.  User, System and Interrupt have 10 ms resolution; Interrupt is 0 unless the tile is pinned

wait.description: Wait (task was runnable but not scheduled)

user.description: User (task was scheduled and executing in user mode)

system.description: System (task was scheduled and executing in kernel mode)

interrupt.description: Interrupt (CPU time stolen by hardirq/softirq handlers or a hypervisor; fixed tiles only)

park_attempted.description: Times the tile tried to park while idle (efficient mode), by result

pending.description: Pre-park recheck found work, did not park

device_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Device IRQs on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 for tiles not pinned

tlb_shootdown.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. TLB shootdowns on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 for tiles not pinned

timer_irq.description: counter: cumulative since tile start, query deltas. Local timer interrupts (LOC) on the tile's dedicated CPU, 0 for tiles not pinned

call_handled.description: Calls received, by method, before authentication

conn_capacity.description: Connections the server can hold at once

call_capacity.description: Calls the server can hold at once

subscription_class_used.description: Subscription classes in use, one per distinct filter set

subscription_class_capacity.description: Subscription classes the server can hold at once

last_processed_slot.description: Last slot reported processed, 0 if none

last_confirmed_slot.description: Last slot reported confirmed, 0 if none

last_finalized_slot.description: Last slot reported finalized, 0 if none

conn_closed.description: Connections closed, by the peer or the server

conn_evicted.description: Connections the server closed on its own, by reason

idle.description: No traffic for the idle timeout

handshake.description: The HTTP/2 handshake did not complete in time

burst_stall.description: The connection held a burst send buffer while the kernel took none of its bytes

reset_flood.description: The peer reset streams faster than the limit

slow_client.description: A client that did not keep up never took the status that ended its subscription

conn_full_rejected.description: Connections refused with a GOAWAY because every connection slot was taken

conn_address_full_rejected.description: Connections refused with a GOAWAY because their address already held max_clients_per_address connections

accept_failed.description: Failed attempts to accept a connection

poll_failed.description: Failed epoll operations on the server's sockets

request_rx_bytes.description: Request message bytes received from clients

auth.description: The x-token metadata was missing or wrong

decode.description: The request message could not be decoded

filter.description: The subscribe request violates a filter limit

from_slot.description: The subscribe request asks to replay from a past slot

commitment.description: The subscribe request asks for a commitment level this server does not serve

malformed.description: The transport found the request malformed or unsupported

buffer_evicted.description: Every request buffer was in use and this request had been arriving the longest

buffer_timeout.description: The request message did not finish arriving within the reassembly deadline

buffer_address.description: The peer address already held its share of the request buffers

request_buffer_free.description: Request buffers not on loan to any call

update_tx.description: Update messages sent to subscribers, by type

update_tx_bytes.description: Update message bytes sent to subscribers, by type

ping_tx.description: Server side pings sent on subscription streams

pong_tx.description: Pongs sent in reply to a client ping

msg_tx.description: Response messages handed to the transport

msg_tx_bytes.description: Response message bytes handed to the transport, before compression

msg_wire_tx_bytes.description: Response message bytes sent on the wire, after compression

msg_shared_tx.description: Response messages a subscriber took from bytes staged once for several subscribers

msg_oversize_rejected.description: Sends refused because the message is larger than [tiles.dragon.max_message_bytes]

encode_failed.description: Messages that did not fit the encoder's buffer

txn_meta_build_failed.description: Commit records whose transaction could not be parsed, so nothing was sent for them

cuckoo_filter_installed.description: Cuckoo account filters installed by subscriptions

call_evicted.description: Calls the transport closed, by reason

send_ring.description: The send ring needed back bytes the call had not sent

ref_queue.description: The call held as many pending segments as it may

ref_pool.description: The shared pool of pending segments ran out and the call held the most of it

deadline.description: The grpc-timeout of the call ran out

subscription_lagged_closed.description: Subscription streams ended because the client did not keep up

subscription_content_lost_closed.description: Subscription streams ended with an error because a bank whose content they wanted was lost

update_queue_chunk_free.description: Chunks of the shared update queue not on loan to any call

update_queue_chunk_capacity.description: Chunks of the shared update queue, one per call plus the pool

burst_buffer_free.description: Burst send buffers not on loan to any connection

burst_buffer_capacity.description: Burst send buffers the server has

burst_buffer_acquired.description: Times a connection whose send ring ran short took a burst send buffer

burst_buffer_denied.description: Times a connection whose send ring ran short found no burst send buffer free, or its address holding its share

replay_frag_rx.description: Fragments received on the replay link

slot_complete_rx.description: Completed slot messages received from the replay tile

replay_overrun.description: Times the tile fell behind the replay link and had to resynchronize

slot_status_reported.description: Slot statuses reported by the fork graph, by status

blockhash_count.description: Blockhash statuses retained for the blockhash validity call

block_meta_count.description: Block metas retained for the unary calls

bank_capacity.description: Banks the fork graph can hold

bank_ref_count.description: Replay bank references the fork graph has not given back yet

bank_ref_release_pending.description: Bank reference releases waiting to be published to replay

bank_pending.description: Banks that owe a confirmed or finalized status, waiting for the records of their block

bank_created.description: Banks added to the fork graph

bank_discarded.description: Banks dropped from the fork graph, by reason

loser.description: Another bank of the slot was confirmed or rooted

dropped.description: Replay asked for the bank reference back

pruned.description: The bank does not descend from the root

stale.description: The bank never resolved and fell behind

flushed.description: Replay restarted its bank sequence, or an input gap

pending.description: The bank owed a commitment status its records never let it seal for

bank_incomplete_seen.description: Times a bank was found not sealed, by reason

pending.description: The bank has not frozen yet

dropped.description: The bank reference was taken back

record_missing.description: Fewer transaction records than the bank executed

sysvar_missing.description: A sysvar write of the slot was not seen

gap.description: An input link overran, so records may be missing

bank_evicted.description: Banks dropped to make room in the fork graph

bank_sealed.description: Banks reported sealed, which is when their block can be served

fork_graph_flushed.description: Times the whole fork graph was dropped

bank_ref_released.description: Bank references given back to replay

bank_ref_queue_full_lost.description: Bank references that could not be queued for release, recovered on the next input gap

bank_ref_unnamed_lost.description: Bank references given up without a release because the bank had no pool index, recovered on the next input gap

bank_unknown_dropped.description: Notifications naming a bank the fork graph never saw

root_chain_gap_seen.description: Root advances whose chain of ancestors did not reach the previous root, so some banks were pruned without a finalized status

bank_pending_entered.description: Times a bank's confirmed or finalized status had to wait for the records of its block

bank_pending_timed_out.description: Banks whose owed status went out without their content because the records it waited for never arrived

bank_pending_dropped.description: Banks whose owed status went out without their content because the records it waited for are gone

bank_degraded.description: Banks given up on at the confirmed and finalized levels because the buffer could not hold one of their entries

content_lost.description: Banks that reached confirmed or finalized without the buffer being able to serve their content, whose slot status went out regardless

record_rx.description: Complete records reassembled from the record links

txn_event_rx.description: Transaction events received from the event links

record_multi_frag_rx.description: Records that did not fit one fragment

record_malformed_dropped.description: Records dropped because their framing or their fields did not hold up

record_gap_dropped.description: Partial records dropped because the tile fell behind a record link

record_bad_chunk_dropped.description: Record fragments skipped because they named a chunk outside the link's dcache

record_bank_gone_dropped.description: Records dropped because the bank they name is gone or has no room

record_overrun.description: Times the tile fell behind a record link

record_gap_flushed.description: Times the banks in flight were given up on because a record link lost fragments

txn_record_processed.description: Commit records accounted for against a bank

write_record_processed.description: Runtime write records accounted for against a bank

account_write_processed.description: Account writes taken from the records

account_write_processed_bytes.description: Account data bytes carried by the account writes taken from the records

record_link_lag_peak.description: Most fragments a record link was ever seen to be ahead of the tile, which the link depth bounds

record_size_bytes.description: Size of the commit records reassembled from the record links

buffer_bank_count.description: Banks the buffer holds entries or a block summary for

buffer_bank_capacity.description: Banks the buffer's bank table can hold

buffer_entry_count.description: Transactions and account writes the buffer holds for banks not yet served

buffer_entry_capacity.description: Entries the buffer's index can hold

buffer_entry_peak.description: Most entries the buffer ever held for banks not yet served at once

buffer_used_bytes.description: Bytes of the buffer's ring from the oldest entry of a bank not yet served to the write position

buffer_peak_bytes.description: Most bytes of the buffer's ring that banks not yet served ever spanned at once

buffer_entry_stored.description: Entries written to the buffer, by type

reward.description: Encoded epoch rewards of a block

buffer_entry_oversize_dropped.description: Entries larger than the whole ring, whose bank was given up on

buffer_bank_full_dropped.description: Banks the buffer's bank table had no room for

buffer_overrun.description: Banks whose entries the ring overwrote before they were served, which is a buffer too small for the finalization lag

account_read.description: Accounts read at a bank's fork of the accounts database

account_closed_read.description: Account reads that found no account, which is an account the block closed

account_data_missing_skipped.description: Account writes not served because the record carried the account's identity but not its data

account_partial_skipped.description: Account updates not sent because the buffer holds less of the account's data than the subscription asked for

account_oversize_dropped.description: Account updates dropped because they are larger than one message may be, which is [tiles.dragon.max_message_bytes]

block_oversize_dropped.description: Blocks dropped because they are larger than one message may be, which is [tiles.dragon.max_message_bytes]

account_read_duration_nanos.description: Time to read one account at a bank's fork of the accounts database

pending_ref_peak_per_call.description: Most pending output segments a call held at once, sampled when the call ends
